title: Graph supersession engine
description: Objective: implement immutable new revisions, graph epochs, consequence-equivalent carry/change/remove/drain dispositions, and atomic activation. Deliverable: core/scheduler supersession modules with exhaustive race/property tests. NOT in scope: rewriting history or implicit approval carry. Hard dependencies: Fan-in integration pipeline, Same-bug circuit breaker, Lease presence core, and Policy approval core. Owned paths: packages/core/src/supersession/** and packages/scheduler/src/supersession/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Old and new revisions never hold overlapping authority outside an explicit safe carry binding.
Every attempt/effect/resource/budget disposition is complete, deterministic, and hash bound.
Changed or unknown authority/input facts invalidate carry and stale epochs cannot mutate current state.
Focused core and scheduler tests pass.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
